projects.title: Honji Pictionary
projects.summary: Big ideas. Questionable drawings. A drawing party game with an AI judge.
projects.description: Create a room, invite your friends, and turn a shared screen and a handful of phones into a drawing competition. Everyone gets the same prompt and three minutes to make it recognizable.
details: Up to 10 players join with a room code and sketch their own avatars.
AI-generated prompts, a timed drawing canvas, and ranked results with playful feedback.
Built with React, TypeScript, HTML Canvas, Vercel, Upstash Redis, and the OpenAI API.

projects.title: AR You Learning
projects.imageAlt: AR You Learning adventure selection with Animals, Colors, and Cars
projects.summary: Spelling, augmented reality, and lessons to take with you.
projects.description: A children’s learning game that connects words, pictures, and augmented reality. The redesigned app adds downloadable lessons, supported by a companion lesson library.
details: Download lessons with 3D models to explore in augmented reality.
Downloaded lessons can be used offline.
A companion Lesson Studio provides lesson editing, 3D model previews, and change review before publication.

projects.title: Stats Don’t Lie
projects.imageAlt: Stats Don't Lie basketball app artwork
projects.summary: A race against the clock, powered by player stats.
projects.description: A time-attack quiz that challenges players to compare individual player statistics and pick the answer that fits the question. A results screen shows the answers they got right and wrong.
details: A timed quiz flow leads from the main screen through gameplay to a results summary.
